source_first_claims.claim: External task: hidden relevant category face/house switches with reversal probability, visible compound face/house cues, choice old/young and probabilistic outcome.
Agent assumes hidden binary Markov HMM state x_t with transition r and outcome emission v given choice and cue.
Agent maps current-state marginal beliefs to action probability through fixed-precision gamma softmax.

source_first_claims.original_published_pdf_or_complete_corre: original p14 Eq5–8 / official correction C3
source_first_claims.claim: Original five fitted schemes S1 pure filter (window length one), S2–S5 joint state-window length two through five use preceding inferred boundary distribution from prior joint window.
Bayesian filtering computes state current marginal using transition from previous filtered current state and new observation.
Sequence inference joint posterior can be marginalised at each time index to produce individual state posterior.
Original sequential rolling window boundary p(x_(t−n)|o_(1:t−1)) has been smoothed with later evidence by prior joint sequential step.
First-order HMM states have conditional independence: future present state conditionally depends on immediately prior state, not earlier sequence when previous known.
Corrected optimal sequential window recursion uses boundary filtered posterior p(x_(t−n)|o_(1:t−n)), not smoothed prior-window reuse.
Under corrected optimal sequence recursion present-state marginal identical to filtering in original Markov task, so behavioral current-state choice predictions are observationally indistinguishable.
Publisher explicitly withdraws claim original suboptimal fitted sequence model offers equally optimal but behaviorally distinct strategy; original analyses and values remain numerically unchanged.

Original simulations under particular r/v demonstrate original S2/S3 suboptimal rolling scheme different trajectories than original S1 filter; do not relabel simulated comparison as corrected optimal-vs-filter.
Original model memory depth n causes 2^n joint state configurations; finite tested window 1–5 and first-order environment, no non-Markovian task in original.
Preliminary Q1 single action-value, Q2 simultaneous pair values, Q3 asymmetric reward learning rate alternatives compared with HMM filtering S1.
Original main text reports better source S1 HMM-vs-Q prelim evidence; no claims beyond main source tabulations absent visual supplemental S1.
Source-original random effects comparisons of fitted S1–S5 favored original S2 on average, with individual S3 or longer variation; this is fitted original SUBOPTIMAL scheme superiority.
Original younger group higher inferred r and v and choice accuracy; interpretation potentially gamma parameter confound.

source_first_claims.original_published_pdf_or_complete_corre: original p14 Eq4 and p7 Results
source_first_claims.claim: Gamma softmax precision fixed during model fitting due parameter redundancy, so recovered r/v and age differences may absorb choice stochasticity.
Source used model-fit difference ΔLL and best sequence length L in VBM multiple regression with sex, age, intracranial, r, v and average fit covariates.
Original left anterior PFC ΔLL relation, posterior parietal and hippocampal L relations are structural morphological correlations, not direct functional or causal neuronal mechanism.
11/79 fitted L=1 could use optimal sequential as well as filtering, making original L=1 strategy labels ambiguous.
ΔLL can index suboptimal sequential vs optimal inference as well as sequential-vs-filter strategy and alters causal interpretation of unchanged VBM regressions.

Source analysis includes 79 accepted adults across younger/older cohorts, seven additional technical exclusions from nominal recruitment; four sessions, 128 probabilistic reversal trials with feedback validity 0.85.
Original n-back partial relation L only trend p=.057; no clear Raven relation or ΔLL n-back association; avoid full cognition transfer.
The source task itself is Markovian; conjectured benefits for non-Markovian language/sequence settings not directly tested.

Original inference claims have distinct levels: representing past states plausibly supported against tested simple filter; optimal strategy superiority invalid after correction; no unique neuronal explanation.

Official S1 contains additional preliminary model comparison/structural posthoc tables but full supplement content has not been independently semantically verified and exact additional values remain excluded.
